core.navigation.collections.label: Collections
core.abilities.collection.manage.label: Manage collections
core.collections.title: Collections
core.collections.description: Strands of productions with a page of their own, such as a festival or a series of studio shows. A production can be in several.
core.collections.new-description: Give it a name and a colour now. You add its productions and its page on the next screen.
core.collections.empty-description: Collections are optional. Use one to give a festival or a series its own page.
core.collections.name: Name
core.collections.colour-help: Used for its chips and on the timetable. Text on it must be easy to read.
core.collections.season-help: Choose a season to take only that season's productions, as for a festival. Leave it open for a series that runs across seasons.
core.collections.address-help: If you change it once the collection has been public, the old address still leads here.
core.collections.summary-help: One or two sentences, shown at the top of its page.
core.collections.page-help: The rest of its page. You can use Markdown.
core.collections.delete-consequence: The collection is removed. Its productions are not changed.
core.collections.productions-help: In the order its page shows them. Only published productions appear there.
core.collections.productions-bound: Only productions in {season} can join. In the order its page shows them; only published productions appear there.
core.collections.order-help: Press the up or down arrow to move this production, or drag it.
core.collections.no-productions-descript: Search for a production above to add it.
core.collections.production-help: The collections this production is part of. Its page shows each one once both are published.
